items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1967-02-09
items.q: There was no Max Roach or nothing like that.

ctx.x: Do you think the same goes for European rhythm sections? Because I think this is where we tend to fall short of the American.

I heard, that question has been asked before. You got some of these bands don't have a solid beat, you know. But you take these pros that I was, like I told you about this BBC thing that I've heard with the small group. That cats has got nothing but rhythm show. Drummers, oh, come on. There's no more bad drummers in a good band, you know what I mean. I heard a recording date the other day in the studio here, right here in London. And man, them cats was really playing. There was no Max Roach or nothing like that.…
